Rajasthan Principal's Face Blackened Over Molestation Allegations

In Ajmer, Rajasthan, villagers and students protested against a school principal accused of inappropriate behavior towards a 9th-grade student. The protesters, including students, reportedly pulled the principal from a police jeep and blackened his face with ink. Police have detained the principal, and an investigation into the allegations is underway. The incident occurred following a complaint by the student.
